record.question: In the Parliament, there should not be a gap of more than _______ between two consecutive sittings
record.explanation: Answer B: 6 months. Article 85(1) limits the interval from a House’s last sitting in one session to its first sitting in the next to six months. Option B is the intended interval. Historical/source note: The precise rule is between sessions’ last/first sittings; the original compresses that to consecutive sittings. Reference: https://www.legislative.gov.in/static/uploads/2025/08/7af1daa22d65f9d04c00ae9b9aa5a799.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
